title: CuteAFD v5.0.0 core precision at long context: BF16 reference, HQA and K6 core on graded tasks from 4K to 127K tokens
question: On CuteAFD v5.0.0 with two RTX PRO 6000, what does the precision of the tensors outside the K4 experts (BF16 core, BF16 q_b_proj and o_proj with K6 elsewhere, K6 core) buy on graded tasks as context grows from 4K to 127K tokens, delivered as one message and over eight turns?

goals.headline: Exploratory, one run per arm; anchor not in this step. Cold prefill twice bit-identical in all 46 completed conversations; 1-row and 64-row decode replays identical; the live cache-resumed path against the replay bit-identical in 45 of 46 (the exception, compact join-000-64k with 8 parts, is read as a harness artifact). Cold in one prefill against prefill cut at turn frontiers is never bit-equal (KL mean 0.001-0.02); live against cold 0.002-0.04. The protocol reads this as an engine property and not a precision effect, by inference from layer 1, and lists eight design limits for a second version.
